notes.title: Holiday Update: Oculus Touch Integration, Shotgun Achievements, Snowman!
notes.content:
Today we released an update that added Oculus Touch support, opened the shotgun achievements back up, and changed the way Vive users grab arrows from the quiver (hopefully the touchpad will be easier on the arms). There is also a snowman.


[h1] Patch Notes:[/h1]

- Oculus: Touch support added
- Vive: players now grab arrows/shells by pushing on the touchpad
- Wingshooter shotgun achievements activated
- Various minor menu changes made
- There is a snowman

We will be holding a shotgun streamer tournament over the holidays, so we wanted to allow more players to unlock these achievements now. More on that to come.

Happy Holidays!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26633762/85570bb72dfd8f696d83e2cd57b0b3c5dd4de687.png[/img]

notes.title: Wingshooter Classic Update
notes.content:
Thank you, players, for making this inaugural Skyhearth Wingshooter Classic a success. We're really happy about the response and grateful for your feedback. Thank you!

Champions, we know you all are excited about receiving your new game mode and shotgun models. It's really important to us that both motion-tracked controller and head aiming are done, good, and most of all fun. They're very close, but we're still tweaking and polishing. It's Thanksgiving here in the U.S, but we'll keep working on the new mode during the holiday and players will be able to access it on Monday after the tournament ends. We hope you'll understand and thank you for your patience.

Don't forget, you still have until Sunday to get the new mode with a score of 50 or better and improve your score to 75 or better to earn the deluxe model.

Cheers and Happy Thanksgiving!
Tiny Lions

notes.title: Vive Controller Support Added
notes.content:
Today we updated [b]Plenty: Skyhearth[/b] to include tracked motion controller support for HTC Vive players.  From the Settings menu, Vive users can select between head aiming or using the hand controllers, as well as right-handed or left-handed controls.  

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]ambidextrous tracked motion controller support for HTC Vive
  [*]minor adjustments to arrow size and speed
  [*]adjustments to sound and vibration effects when using HTC Vive tracked motion controllers
[/list]
In-game leaderboards and ambidextrous head aiming will be added in an update early next week and Oculus Touch support is coming soon. Thank you for your feedback.

notes.title: Updates Incoming!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Thanks for giving Plenty: Skyhearth a shot and for all the great feedback. We have two updates on the way:[/b] 

[h1]Tracked Motion Controllers[/h1]

Vive players, we hear you! Tracked motion controllers for aiming, drawing, and shooting will be added as an option by next week. You'll still have the option to aim using head motion, but it will be up to you.

[h1]Leaderboards In-Game[/h1]

We’re finishing an update that incorporates leaderboards in-game and addresses a few other minor issues. Being able to view the leaderboards before and after a round is a important to us and will also support upcoming tournaments.

Please don’t hesitate to join or continue the conversation about VR and Plenty: Skyhearth in the discussion page and let us know if you come across any bugs or issues. Thanks!
 
Tiny Lions
